Cargo bike trip and range: Njem na ogologo ịnyịnya ígwè ibu
How far an electric cargo tricycle gets: Ebe ịnyịnya ígwè ibu nwere ụkwụ atọ eletrik nwere ike ịga ma lọghachi n'otu chaj batrị, n'elu ugwu ma na-ahọrọ ụzọ ịnyịnya ígwè, na ihe ọ na-echekwa ma e jiri ya tụnyere ụgbọ ala (ịzụta, mmanụ, ụtụ isi, inshọransị, ebe nchekwa ụgbọ, nlekọta), n'ime taabụ nke ya.
Round trip from a start point to a desti: Njem ịga na ịlọghachi site n'ebe mmalite ruo ebe a na-aga n'okporo ụzọ ịnyịnya ígwè nwere ike iji (na-ahọrọ ụzọ ịnyịnya ígwè) na batrị e jiri n'elu ala, yana map ogologo na-egosi ebe ịnyịnya ígwè nwere ike ịga ma lọghachi n'akụkụ ọ bụla.
Yearly cost of the cargo bike against a: Ọnụ ahịa kwa afọ nke ịnyịnya ígwè ibu ma e jiri ya tụnyere ụgbọ ala maka otu njem ahụ: ịzụta, ike, ụtụ isi, inshọransị, ebe nchekwa ụgbọ na nlekọta, n'ego obodo ebe mmalite.
